description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimDao class, which serves as a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing claim-related entities in the OrangeHRM system. The class includes methods for saving, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim events, expenses, requests, attachments, and expense types. It employs Doctrine ORM query builders for database interactions and handles filtering, paging, and entity state management within the claim module of the system.

classes.name: ClaimDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for handling claim-related database operations, including CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and integrity checks within the OrangeHRM claim module.
